definition: to go beyond a limit
sentences: Our Q2 results ____ all internal forecasts by a wide margin.
Our Q2 results harmonise all internal forecasts by a wide margin.
Our Q2 results exceed all internal forecasts by a wide margin.
Our Q2 results incubate all internal forecasts by a wide margin.
explanation: 'Exceed' = surpass; collocates with expectations, target, limit.
explanationJa: 「exceed」は超えるという意味で、expectations, target, limit と結びつきます。

definition: waiting to be decided
sentences: The contract is ____ legal review and should clear by Friday.
The contract is harmonising legal review and should clear by Friday.
The contract is pending legal review and should clear by Friday.
The contract is evaporating legal review and should clear by Friday.
explanation: 'Pending' = awaiting completion; adjective or preposition.
explanationJa: 「pending」は完了待ちという意味で、形容詞・前置詞として使います。

definition: temporary, in the meantime
sentences: She will serve as ____ CEO until a permanent hire is made.
She will serve as harmonious CEO until a permanent hire is made.
She will serve as crystalline CEO until a permanent hire is made.
She will serve as interim CEO until a permanent hire is made.
explanation: 'Interim' = temporary, during the interval; senior business term.
explanationJa: 「interim」は暫定・つなぎという意味で、上級ビジネス用語です。

definition: to put in agreement or coordination
sentences: The proposal must ____ with our long-term strategy.
The proposal must germinate with our long-term strategy.
The proposal must align with our long-term strategy.
The proposal must harvest with our long-term strategy.
explanation: 'Align with' = match, be consistent with; strategic vocabulary.
explanationJa: 「align with」は〜と一致する・整合するという戦略用語です。

definition: to give a task to someone else
sentences: Good managers know how to ____ routine work to their team.
Good managers know how to germinate routine work to their team.
Good managers know how to delegate routine work to their team.
Good managers know how to evaporate routine work to their team.
explanation: 'Delegate' = entrust to a subordinate; leadership skill.
explanationJa: 「delegate」は部下に仕事を任せることで、リーダーシップの技能です。

definition: general agreement
sentences: The board reached a ____ on the new pricing strategy.
The board reached a glacier on the new pricing strategy.
The board reached a consensus on the new pricing strategy.
The board reached a hailstorm on the new pricing strategy.
explanation: 'Consensus' = collective agreement; 'reach a consensus' is fixed.
explanationJa: 「consensus」は集団の合意のことで、reach a consensus は固定表現です。

definition: to predict future numbers
sentences: Analysts ____ a 12% increase in sales next quarter.
Analysts harmonise a 12% increase in sales next quarter.
Analysts germinate a 12% increase in sales next quarter.
Analysts forecast a 12% increase in sales next quarter.
explanation: 'Forecast' = predict, usually with data; verb and noun.
explanationJa: 「forecast」は通常データに基づいて予測するという意味で、動詞・名詞両方で使います。

definition: unfinished work piled up
sentences: The support team is working through a large ____ of tickets.
The support team is working through a large hailstorm of tickets.
The support team is working through a large backlog of tickets.
The support team is working through a large meadow of tickets.
explanation: 'Backlog' = accumulated unfinished work.
explanationJa: 「backlog」は溜まった未処理業務のことです。

definition: a significant point in a project
sentences: Completing the prototype was a major ____ for the team.
Completing the prototype was a major mountain for the team.
Completing the prototype was a major milestone for the team.
Completing the prototype was a major thunderstorm for the team.
explanation: 'Milestone' = key project event marking progress.
explanationJa: 「milestone」は進捗を示す重要なプロジェクトイベントのことです。

definition: a person with interest in a project
sentences: Every ____ must approve the design before production begins.
Every stakeholder must approve the design before production begins.
Every glacier must approve the design before production begins.
Every horizon must approve the design before production begins.
explanation: 'Stakeholder' = party with an interest in or influence over a project.
explanationJa: 「stakeholder」はプロジェクトに利害や影響力を持つ関係者のことです。

definition: to use to maximum effect
sentences: We should ____ our existing customer relationships to drive sales.
We should evaporate our existing customer relationships to drive sales.
We should germinate our existing customer relationships to drive sales.
We should leverage our existing customer relationships to drive sales.
explanation: 'Leverage' as verb = use strategically to gain advantage.
explanationJa: 動詞「leverage」は戦略的に活用して優位を得るという意味です。

definition: to coordinate between people
sentences: I'll ____ with both teams to finalise the rollout schedule.
I'll evaporate with both teams to finalise the rollout schedule.
I'll liaise with both teams to finalise the rollout schedule.
I'll germinate with both teams to finalise the rollout schedule.
explanation: 'Liaise with' = act as a coordinator/bridge between parties.
explanationJa: 「liaise with」は当事者間の調整役・橋渡しをするという意味です。

definition: a supplier or seller
sentences: We've shortlisted three ____ for the catering contract.
We've shortlisted three vendors for the catering contract.
We've shortlisted three icebergs for the catering contract.
We've shortlisted three glaciers for the catering contract.
explanation: 'Vendor' = a company supplying goods or services.
explanationJa: 「vendor」は商品やサービスを供給する企業のことです。

definition: to officially choose for a position
sentences: The board will ____ a new CFO next month.
The board will appoint a new CFO next month.
The board will germinate a new CFO next month.
The board will evaporate a new CFO next month.
explanation: 'Appoint' = formally assign someone to a role.
explanationJa: 「appoint」は正式に役職に任命するという意味です。

definition: to supervise
sentences: She will ____ the merger integration process for both firms.
She will germinate the merger integration process for both firms.
She will oversee the merger integration process for both firms.
She will harmonise the merger integration process for both firms.
explanation: 'Oversee' = supervise from a higher level; manage broadly.
explanationJa: 「oversee」は上の立場から監督・統括するという意味です。

definition: to sell off a business unit
sentences: The conglomerate plans to ____ its underperforming retail arm.
The conglomerate plans to harmonise its underperforming retail arm.
The conglomerate plans to germinate its underperforming retail arm.
The conglomerate plans to divest its underperforming retail arm.
explanation: 'Divest' = strategically sell off assets or divisions.
explanationJa: 「divest」は資産や部門を戦略的に売却するという意味です。

definition: to avoid by going around
sentences: The firm tried to ____ the new tariffs by routing through Mexico.
The firm tried to germinate the new tariffs by routing through Mexico.
The firm tried to circumvent the new tariffs by routing through Mexico.
The firm tried to evaporate the new tariffs by routing through Mexico.
explanation: 'Circumvent' = find a way around an obstacle or rule.
explanationJa: 「circumvent」は障害や規則を回避する方法を見つけるという意味です。

definition: gradual loss of staff or customers
sentences: Customer ____ has risen since the price increase took effect.
Customer hurricane has risen since the price increase took effect.
Customer marmalade has risen since the price increase took effect.
Customer attrition has risen since the price increase took effect.
explanation: 'Attrition' = gradual reduction; 'employee/customer attrition' are common.
explanationJa: 「attrition」は徐々に減少することで、employee/customer attrition がよく使われます。

definition: to lose as a penalty
sentences: By withdrawing early, the firm will ____ its deposit.
By withdrawing early, the firm will harmonise its deposit.
By withdrawing early, the firm will forfeit its deposit.
By withdrawing early, the firm will germinate its deposit.
explanation: 'Forfeit' = give up or lose as a penalty; legal/financial register.
explanationJa: 「forfeit」は罰として失う・放棄するという意味で、法務財務的な語感です。

definition: to make happen faster
sentences: Can you ____ this order? The client urgently needs it by Monday.
Can you germinate this order? The client urgently needs it by Monday.
Can you evaporate this order? The client urgently needs it by Monday.
Can you expedite this order? The client urgently needs it by Monday.
explanation: 'Expedite' = accelerate; commonly used in logistics and admin.
explanationJa: 「expedite」は加速するという意味で、物流や事務でよく使われます。

definition: to combine into one
sentences: We plan to ____ three regional offices into a single hub.
We plan to germinate three regional offices into a single hub.
We plan to consolidate three regional offices into a single hub.
We plan to evaporate three regional offices into a single hub.
explanation: 'Consolidate' = merge or unify into a single, stronger entity.
explanationJa: 「consolidate」は単一の強固な存在に統合するという意味です。

definition: to find out for certain
sentences: We need to ____ the cause of the system failure before resuming.
We need to germinate the cause of the system failure before resuming.
We need to ascertain the cause of the system failure before resuming.
We need to harmonise the cause of the system failure before resuming.
explanation: 'Ascertain' = formally determine or verify; near-synonym of 'establish'.
explanationJa: 「ascertain」は正式に確かめる・特定するという意味で、establish の類義語です。

definition: to gradually move into another's space
sentences: The competitor is starting to ____ on our core market.
The competitor is starting to germinate on our core market.
The competitor is starting to harmonise on our core market.
The competitor is starting to encroach on our core market.
explanation: 'Encroach on' = gradually intrude into; common in territorial business contexts.
explanationJa: 「encroach on」は徐々に侵入するという意味で、領域的なビジネス文脈で使われます。

definition: to assign to a lower position
sentences: The brand was ____ to a secondary status after the controversy.
The brand was germinated to a secondary status after the controversy.
The brand was relegated to a secondary status after the controversy.
The brand was evaporated to a secondary status after the controversy.
explanation: 'Relegate' = demote, push down to a lesser role.
explanationJa: 「relegate」は降格させる・低い役割に押しやるという意味です。

definition: to give a new and better form
sentences: Marketing plans to ____ the entire website by autumn.
Marketing plans to germinate the entire website by autumn.
Marketing plans to harmonise the entire website by autumn.
Marketing plans to revamp the entire website by autumn.
explanation: 'Revamp' = thoroughly refresh, redesign, or modernise.
explanationJa: 「revamp」は徹底的に刷新・再設計・近代化するという意味です。

definition: to support or form the basis of
sentences: Strong ethics ____ every decision the board makes.
Strong ethics evaporate every decision the board makes.
Strong ethics underpin every decision the board makes.
Strong ethics germinate every decision the board makes.
explanation: 'Underpin' = provide the foundation for; figurative use.
explanationJa: 「underpin」は基盤を提供するという比喩的な意味で使われます。

definition: to act before someone else can
sentences: The CEO held a press call to ____ negative media coverage.
The CEO held a press call to germinate negative media coverage.
The CEO held a press call to preempt negative media coverage.
The CEO held a press call to harmonise negative media coverage.
explanation: 'Preempt' = take action first to prevent something.
explanationJa: 「preempt」は何かを未然に防ぐため先に行動することです。

definition: depending on something else
sentences: Bonuses are ____ on meeting both revenue and retention targets.
Bonuses are crystalline on meeting both revenue and retention targets.
Bonuses are contingent on meeting both revenue and retention targets.
Bonuses are aromatic on meeting both revenue and retention targets.
explanation: 'Contingent on/upon' = conditional upon; formal business register.
explanationJa: 「contingent on/upon」は条件付きという意味で、格式あるビジネス用語です。

definition: to make accounts agree
sentences: The accountant must ____ the bank statement with our ledger.
The accountant must germinate the bank statement with our ledger.
The accountant must harmonise the bank statement with our ledger.
The accountant must reconcile the bank statement with our ledger.
explanation: 'Reconcile' = match two sets of records; finance vocabulary.
explanationJa: 「reconcile」は2つの記録を一致させるという財務用語です。

definition: to rise and fall irregularly
sentences: Oil prices continue to ____ amid geopolitical tensions.
Oil prices continue to germinate amid geopolitical tensions.
Oil prices continue to fluctuate amid geopolitical tensions.
Oil prices continue to harmonise amid geopolitical tensions.
explanation: 'Fluctuate' = vary up and down; market/data vocabulary.
explanationJa: 「fluctuate」は上下に変動するという意味で、市場やデータの語彙です。

definition: not certain or definite
sentences: We've set a ____ launch date pending final approval.
We've set a crystalline launch date pending final approval.
We've set a tentative launch date pending final approval.
We've set a aromatic launch date pending final approval.
explanation: 'Tentative' = provisional; common with 'date', 'agreement', 'plan'.
explanationJa: 「tentative」は暫定の・仮のという意味で、date, agreement, plan によく付きます。

definition: producing a lot of money
sentences: The contract proved to be highly ____ for the consultancy.
The contract proved to be highly aromatic for the consultancy.
The contract proved to be highly lucrative for the consultancy.
The contract proved to be highly crystalline for the consultancy.
explanation: 'Lucrative' = profitable; describes deals, markets, contracts.
explanationJa: 「lucrative」は利益が大きいという形容詞で、deals, markets, contracts を表します。

definition: to reduce the severity of something
sentences: The hedge strategy is designed to ____ currency risk.
The hedge strategy is designed to germinate currency risk.
The hedge strategy is designed to mitigate currency risk.
The hedge strategy is designed to harmonise currency risk.
explanation: 'Mitigate' = reduce the impact of; collocates with risk, damage, loss.
explanationJa: 「mitigate」は影響を軽減するという意味で、risk, damage, loss と結びつきます。

definition: never done before
sentences: The company posted ____ growth despite the recession.
The company posted aromatic growth despite the recession.
The company posted crystalline growth despite the recession.
The company posted unprecedented growth despite the recession.
explanation: 'Unprecedented' = without prior example; strong descriptor.
explanationJa: 「unprecedented」は前例のないという強い形容詞です。

definition: a difference between two things
sentences: The audit found a small ____ between reported and actual revenue.
The audit found a small spectrum between reported and actual revenue.
The audit found a small discrepancy between reported and actual revenue.
The audit found a small horizon between reported and actual revenue.
explanation: 'Discrepancy' = mismatch in figures or facts; common in audit reports.
explanationJa: 「discrepancy」は数字や事実の不一致を意味し、監査報告でよく使われます。

definition: a written response
sentences: I haven't received a ____ to my email from yesterday.
I haven't received a meadow to my email from yesterday.
I haven't received a reply to my email from yesterday.
I haven't received a moonbeam to my email from yesterday.
explanation: 'Reply' = answer to a message; noun and verb.
explanationJa: 「reply」はメッセージへの返答で、名詞・動詞両方で使われます。

definition: a list of topics for a meeting
sentences: Please review the ____ before joining the call.
Please review the harbor before joining the call.
Please review the agenda before joining the call.
Please review the orchard before joining the call.
explanation: 'Agenda' = planned topics for a meeting.
explanationJa: 「agenda」は会議で予定された議題のことです。

definition: showing good manners
sentences: She wrote a ____ but firm response to the complaint.
She wrote a aromatic but firm response to the complaint.
She wrote a crystalline but firm response to the complaint.
She wrote a polite but firm response to the complaint.
explanation: 'Polite' = courteous; important register in customer-facing writing.
explanationJa: 「polite」は礼儀正しいという意味で、顧客対応の文体として重要です。

definition: a place where goods are made
sentences: Our main ____ in Vietnam produces 60% of our output.
Our main meadow in Vietnam produces 60% of our output.
Our main factory in Vietnam produces 60% of our output.
Our main glacier in Vietnam produces 60% of our output.
explanation: 'Factory' = manufacturing plant.
explanationJa: 「factory」は製造工場のことです。

definition: to make something happen later
sentences: Bad weather will ____ all flights this evening.
Bad weather will harmonise all flights this evening.
Bad weather will germinate all flights this evening.
Bad weather will delay all flights this evening.
explanation: 'Delay' = postpone; verb and noun.
explanationJa: 「delay」は遅らせるという意味で、動詞・名詞両方で使われます。

definition: how much something costs
sentences: The new ____ list will take effect from January.
The new orchard list will take effect from January.
The new meadow list will take effect from January.
The new price list will take effect from January.
explanation: 'Price list' = compound noun, standard in commerce.
explanationJa: 「price list」は価格表という複合名詞で、商業の標準語彙です。

definition: to employ someone
sentences: We plan to ____ two new developers this quarter.
We plan to germinate two new developers this quarter.
We plan to hire two new developers this quarter.
We plan to harmonise two new developers this quarter.
explanation: 'Hire' = employ; common in HR and recruiting.
explanationJa: 「hire」は雇うという意味で、人事や採用で頻出します。

definition: a planned gathering
sentences: The weekly team ____ runs from 9 to 10 every Monday.
The weekly team hurricane runs from 9 to 10 every Monday.
The weekly team meeting runs from 9 to 10 every Monday.
The weekly team blizzard runs from 9 to 10 every Monday.
explanation: 'Meeting' = formal gathering; one of the most-used business words.
explanationJa: 「meeting」は正式な集まりで、ビジネスで最も使われる単語の一つです。

definition: someone who buys goods or services
sentences: A satisfied ____ is the best advertisement for our brand.
A satisfied volcano is the best advertisement for our brand.
A satisfied glacier is the best advertisement for our brand.
A satisfied customer is the best advertisement for our brand.
explanation: 'Customer' = buyer of goods/services.
explanationJa: 「customer」は商品やサービスの購入者のことです。

definition: a business organization
sentences: This ____ was founded by two engineers in 1998.
This meadow was founded by two engineers in 1998.
This company was founded by two engineers in 1998.
This sunrise was founded by two engineers in 1998.
explanation: 'Company' = business entity; basic vocabulary.
explanationJa: 「company」は事業体のことで、基本的な語彙です。

definition: a place where business is done
sentences: The ____ will be closed for renovation next week.
The meadow will be closed for renovation next week.
The thunderstorm will be closed for renovation next week.
The office will be closed for renovation next week.
explanation: 'Office' = workplace; foundational business word.
explanationJa: 「office」は職場のことで、ビジネスの基本単語です。

definition: something that is made for sale
sentences: Our flagship ____ has sold over a million units worldwide.
Our flagship pyramid has sold over a million units worldwide.
Our flagship product has sold over a million units worldwide.
Our flagship harbor has sold over a million units worldwide.
explanation: 'Product' = item made or sold; core commerce term.
explanationJa: 「product」は作られる・売られる品物で、商業の中核語彙です。

definition: work done for customers
sentences: Customer ____ is open 24 hours, seven days a week.
Customer pyramid is open 24 hours, seven days a week.
Customer service is open 24 hours, seven days a week.
Customer rainbow is open 24 hours, seven days a week.
explanation: 'Customer service' = support provided to clients.
explanationJa: 「customer service」は顧客に提供されるサポートのことです。

definition: the area or system for buying and selling
sentences: The European ____ is our largest source of revenue.
The European glacier is our largest source of revenue.
The European market is our largest source of revenue.
The European butterfly is our largest source of revenue.
explanation: 'Market' = trading region or system; very high-frequency business word.
explanationJa: 「market」は取引が行われる地域や仕組みで、頻出のビジネス語です。

definition: an agreement, often financial
sentences: The two firms signed a five-year ____ this morning.
The two firms signed a five-year meadow this morning.
The two firms signed a five-year sunrise this morning.
The two firms signed a five-year deal this morning.
explanation: 'Deal' = agreement; commonly 'sign/close a deal'.
explanationJa: 「deal」は取引や合意のことで、sign/close a deal がよく使われます。

definition: an estimated price
sentences: Please send a written ____ for the kitchen installation.
Please send a written meadow for the kitchen installation.
Please send a written hurricane for the kitchen installation.
Please send a written quote for the kitchen installation.
explanation: 'Quote' = price estimate for work to be done.
explanationJa: 「quote」は仕事に対する見積もり価格のことです。

definition: a piece of work to do
sentences: This ____ should take about an hour to complete.
This meadow should take about an hour to complete.
This task should take about an hour to complete.
This volcano should take about an hour to complete.
explanation: 'Task' = a defined unit of work.
explanationJa: 「task」は明確に定義された仕事の単位のことです。

definition: a scheduled time period
sentences: I have a free 30-minute ____ at 3 p.m. for a call.
I have a free 30-minute meadow at 3 p.m. for a call.
I have a free 30-minute slot at 3 p.m. for a call.
I have a free 30-minute sunrise at 3 p.m. for a call.
explanation: 'Slot' = time gap in a schedule; calendar vocabulary.
explanationJa: 「slot」は予定の中の時間枠のことで、カレンダー語彙です。

definition: a set of questions to gather data
sentences: Please complete the customer ____ at the end of the call.
Please complete the customer harbor at the end of the call.
Please complete the customer meadow at the end of the call.
Please complete the customer survey at the end of the call.
explanation: 'Survey' = data-gathering questionnaire.
explanationJa: 「survey」はデータ収集用のアンケートのことです。

definition: a formal written account
sentences: Please submit your weekly ____ by Friday at 5 p.m.
Please submit your weekly meadow by Friday at 5 p.m.
Please submit your weekly orchard by Friday at 5 p.m.
Please submit your weekly report by Friday at 5 p.m.
explanation: 'Report' = formal written document summarising findings.
explanationJa: 「report」は調査結果をまとめた正式な書類のことです。

definition: total income from sales
sentences: Annual ____ exceeded forecasts by twelve percent.
Annual meadow exceeded forecasts by twelve percent.
Annual revenue exceeded forecasts by twelve percent.
Annual harbor exceeded forecasts by twelve percent.
explanation: 'Revenue' = total sales income before costs.
explanationJa: 「revenue」は経費を差し引く前の総売上のことです。

definition: to obtain or buy
sentences: The firm plans to ____ a smaller competitor by year end.
The firm plans to germinate a smaller competitor by year end.
The firm plans to acquire a smaller competitor by year end.
The firm plans to harmonise a smaller competitor by year end.
explanation: 'Acquire' = buy or obtain; M&A vocabulary.
explanationJa: 「acquire」は買収・取得するという意味で、M&A の語彙です。

definition: an estimate of future performance
sentences: Sales ____ for next year remain cautiously optimistic.
Sales meadow for next year remain cautiously optimistic.
Sales projections for next year remain cautiously optimistic.
Sales harbor for next year remain cautiously optimistic.
explanation: 'Projection' = forecast based on current trends.
explanationJa: 「projection」は現在の傾向に基づく予測のことです。

definition: the sequence of steps in a process
sentences: The new tool will improve our ____ across all teams.
The new tool will improve our meadow across all teams.
The new tool will improve our workflow across all teams.
The new tool will improve our hurricane across all teams.
explanation: 'Workflow' = sequence of work steps.
explanationJa: 「workflow」は仕事の手順の流れのことです。

definition: the range covered by something
sentences: The ____ of the project has expanded since last month.
The orchard of the project has expanded since last month.
The scope of the project has expanded since last month.
The pyramid of the project has expanded since last month.
explanation: 'Scope' = boundary or extent of work; PM vocabulary.
explanationJa: 「scope」は仕事の範囲のことで、PM 用語です。

definition: a long-term plan to reach a goal
sentences: Our new digital ____ focuses on emerging markets.
Our new digital meadow focuses on emerging markets.
Our new digital orchard focuses on emerging markets.
Our new digital strategy focuses on emerging markets.
explanation: 'Strategy' = long-term plan; high-frequency business word.
explanationJa: 「strategy」は長期的な計画のことで、頻出のビジネス語です。

definition: a new plan or action
sentences: The wellness ____ has been popular with employees.
The wellness meadow has been popular with employees.
The wellness initiative has been popular with employees.
The wellness orchard has been popular with employees.
explanation: 'Initiative' = new project or programme.
explanationJa: 「initiative」は新しいプロジェクトや取り組みのことです。

definition: to start using something
sentences: Many firms have ____ remote-first work policies.
Many firms have germinated remote-first work policies.
Many firms have adopted remote-first work policies.
Many firms have harmonised remote-first work policies.
explanation: 'Adopt' = take up, begin using; common with policies/practices.
explanationJa: 「adopt」は採用する・使い始めるという意味で、policies/practices に付きます。

definition: a supplier
sentences: The ____ failed to deliver on the agreed schedule.
The orchard failed to deliver on the agreed schedule.
The meadow failed to deliver on the agreed schedule.
The vendor failed to deliver on the agreed schedule.
explanation: 'Vendor' = seller or supplier of goods/services.
explanationJa: 「vendor」は商品やサービスを売る業者のことです。

definition: a violation of a rule or agreement
sentences: The data ____ exposed thousands of customer records.
The data meadow exposed thousands of customer records.
The data harbor exposed thousands of customer records.
The data breach exposed thousands of customer records.
explanation: 'Breach' = violation; 'data breach', 'breach of contract' are common.
explanationJa: 「breach」は違反のことで、data breach, breach of contract がよく使われます。

definition: to expand into new areas
sentences: The firm aims to ____ its portfolio across three new sectors.
The firm aims to germinate its portfolio across three new sectors.
The firm aims to diversify its portfolio across three new sectors.
The firm aims to harmonise its portfolio across three new sectors.
explanation: 'Diversify' = spread investment or activity across areas.
explanationJa: 「diversify」は投資や事業を多角化するという意味です。

definition: the area where authority applies
sentences: This case falls outside the regulator's ____.
This case falls outside the regulator's meadow.
This case falls outside the regulator's jurisdiction.
This case falls outside the regulator's orchard.
explanation: 'Jurisdiction' = legal authority area; common in compliance.
explanationJa: 「jurisdiction」は法的管轄領域のことで、コンプライアンスでよく使われます。
